name: Budgeted Gaussian Splatting
definition: A training and deployment method for large-scale Gaussian Splatting that uses a continuous budget-quality curve to select primitives, allowing for variable primitive counts (LOD) without retraining, achieving near-lossless quality at low compression ratios.
summary: Budgeted Gaussian Splatting enables variable detail levels without retraining by decoupling selection from training, allowing a single model to export to any rasterizer with different budgets.
